google_agent_structure_basis.notes: Google describes agents as AI systems that achieve goals with reasoning, planning, memory, autonomy, observation, action, collaboration, and tool access. Hermes adds explicit evidence/proof/lifecycle governance.

brain-mirror.role: Brain/Kanban projection and governed worker lane
brain-mirror.goal: Mirror canonical brain tasks into Kanban, execute bounded control-plane work, and preserve evidence/provenance.
brain-mirror.escalation: Review-required or blocked when proof, authority, credentials, quota, or safety boundary is insufficient.

default.goal: Handle unassigned general tasks when a specialist profile is not required.
default.planning: Worker prompt plus task acceptance criteria.
default.escalation: Block or request review when task-specific evidence is insufficient.

dev.goal: Implement and verify scoped code changes.
dev.planning: Incremental implementation plan with verification slices.
dev.escalation: Stop for credentials, destructive changes, or ambiguous product authority.

hermes-agent.goal: Modify Hermes Agent features with SSOT, regression tests, and scoped commits.
hermes-agent.planning: Hermes self-optimization workflow with post-update and governance checks.
hermes-agent.escalation: Stop before high-blast-radius runtime routing or destructive profile mutation without explicit authorization.

hermes-core.goal: Maintain agent loop, tool execution, provider routing, and process lifecycle correctness.
hermes-core.escalation: Stop before changing public behavior or safety gates without certification.

workflow.goal: Design and verify durable workflows, taskpool automations, and evidence loops.
workflow.escalation: Stop before enabling broad automation or external side effects.

mlops.goal: Evaluate model routing, inference, RAG, and ML tooling tasks.
mlops.escalation: Stop on missing credentials, quota, or unverifiable model claims.

media.goal: Process media/video/audio/visual tasks with evidence and provenance.
media.planning: Extract, summarize, verify, and index media-derived evidence.
media.escalation: Stop on inaccessible media, private content, or missing user authorization.

personal.goal: Personal-assistant style tasks when explicitly routed.
personal.escalation: Requires explicit routing before Kanban use because it is not currently listed as an assignee.

work.escalation: Requires explicit routing before Kanban use because it is not currently listed as an assignee.

control_plane_local_brain.goal: Keep task/evidence/context sources structured, retrievable, provenance-linked, and truth-gated.
control_plane_local_brain.planning: Classify incoming knowledge into governed tasks, method atoms, or explicit exemptions.
policy: private brain not indexed without authorization
control_plane_local_brain.escalation: Human review for private data, ambiguous source authority, or canonical writer promotion.

control_plane_taskpool.goal: Move work through governed lifecycle without idle-spin, stale projections, or false completion.
control_plane_taskpool.planning: Prioritize, claim, hand off, block/review, and reconcile using lifecycle gates.
control_plane_taskpool.escalation: Human review before broad autorun/routing changes or external side effects.

skill_graph_governance.role: Tool/capability registry and skill promotion governance domain
skill_graph_governance.goal: Convert external or long-form knowledge into safe, maintainable skill candidates.
skill_graph_governance.planning: Score compatibility, distill method atoms, and stage review-first promotions.
skill_graph_governance.escalation: Stop before canonical skill writer or production skill install without explicit review.

visual_ingest_runtime.role: Multimodal observation and visual input runtime domain
visual_ingest_runtime.goal: Handle Rokid/visual inputs as observable tasks with safe user-visible handoff.
visual_ingest_runtime.planning: Classify visual request, process through appropriate vision/runtime path, and return evidence.
visual_ingest_runtime.escalation: Human review for private imagery, permission prompts, or missing input artifact.

multimodel_conductor_architecture.role: Multi-model role orchestration and evaluator/arbiter architecture domain
multimodel_conductor_architecture.goal: Turn static model fanout into role-aware generate/evaluate/refine orchestration with truth gates.
multimodel_conductor_architecture.planning: Assign planner/critic/verifier/arbiter roles and combine evidence under a stable conductor contract.
multimodel_conductor_architecture.escalation: Stop before enabling conductor as default runtime without separate certification and rollback plan.

requires_explicit_followup_authorization: automatic specialist profile routing instead of brain-mirror concentration
runtime Agent Card injection into worker prompts
canonical skill writer / external skill installation
